info.skip_unlucky_mode: Skipping till next bad luck day...
config.open-menu-key-desc: Button needed to press for menu to open
config.skip-one-day-key-desc: Button needed to press to fast skip one day without openning the menu
config.schedule-max-days-name: Max sleeping days limit for special sleeping modes
config.schedule-max-days-desc: While skipping in a special mode (ex. for the next lucky day), if such a day doesn't appear within the limit, stop sleeping
config.section.misc-note: Attention! These settings can lead to unexpected game behavior. Use at your own risk!
config.disable-saving-desc: Turns off saving to make skipping faster. The last skipped night will be saved. It might interfere with game logic, and mods or even blew-up your pc :)
config.disable-fading-desc: Turns off screen fading to black and back to clear
